hooks.command: jq -c '.tool_name as $n | ( $n == "mcp__rikyu-hpc__submit_job" or $n == "mcp__plugin_rikyu_rikyu-hpc__submit_job" or ($n == "Bash" and ((.tool_input.command // "") as $c | ($c|contains("smoke.py --job")) or ($c|contains("sbatch")) or ($c|contains("srun")) or ($c|contains("salloc")))) ) as $ask | if $ask then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"Submits a real, billable job on RIKYU compute with no usage limit configured - confirm before continuing."}} else empty end'
